capabilities: Pull each day's Lareia entry into the daily note between codex markers
Download images and attachments into the attachment folder as embeds
Export Lareia mind maps as .excalidraw.md files
Sync Lareia notebooks into per-folio folders with an index.md
Pair a vault with a Lareia account via a one-time code
disambiguation: Not a journaling or writing tool for Obsidian; it only pulls content written in the Lareia app into your vault.
extras: Free with no AI calls or telemetry; the optional title index sends every note's name and path to Lareia's server and is off by default; the plugin never deletes files and keeps 7-day backups of notes before editing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring entries, attachments and mind maps from the Lareia journal app into vault notes.

relations.evidence: Para vê-lo desenhado, instale o plugin Excalidraw; sem ele, o arquivo abre como texto.
O plugin usa a rede: fala só com a API da Lareia

summary: Integration that pulls your Lareia journal into the vault as daily note entries, downloaded media, Excalidraw mind maps and notebook folders.
